mcp_servers.description: STDIO，PAL MCP Server；通过 uvx 启动并走 OpenAI 兼容网关，模型信息读取本地 PAL 配置文件
mcp_servers.summary: 多模型协作、代码分析与讨论工具，模型信息读取本地 PAL 配置文件。
mcp_servers.credential_url: PAL_API_KEY 可使用公司 sub2api 下发的 Codex API key
args: export CUSTOM_API_URL={PAL_API_BASE_URL_shell}; export CUSTOM_API_KEY="$PAL_API_KEY"; export DEFAULT_MODEL={pal_default_model_shell}; export CUSTOM_MODELS_CONFIG_PATH={pal_custom_models_config_path_shell}; uvx_cmd="$(command -v uvx 2>/dev/null || true)"; for p in "$uvx_cmd" "$HOME/.local/bin/uvx" /opt/homebrew/bin/uvx /usr/local/bin/uvx; do [ -n "$p" ] && [ -x "$p" ] && exec "$p" --from git+https://github.com/BeehiveInnovations/pal-mcp-server.git pal-mcp-server; done; command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec uvx --from git+https://github.com/BeehiveInnovations/pal-mcp-server.git pal-mcp-server; echo 'uvx not found' >&2; exit 1
